acknowledgements.reason: Command-generated lifecycle metadata written by acceptance_basis_generate, a PLAN-phase gate prerequisite. It is not story-authored code or content: this story ran the generator because the gate requires it, and the file records the generated coverage-basis digest and receipt. It fails closed only because acceptance-basis.json is absent from the lifecycle-artifact filename registry that already covers its siblings (proofstory.json, red-evidence.json, intent-collision.json and the rest), so the classifier reports category=unknown rather than lifecycle_artifact.
